desc:
The fastest 6v6 FPS on Roblox: no waiting, no pay-to-win, just pure gunplay. Jump in and you're fighting in seconds.

PixelWar is a tactical multiplayer shooter. Slide, lean round corners, cook grenades and call in scorestreaks across 16 hand-built maps, from tight container yards to airports, snowbound villages and jungle ruins.

🔫 37 guns: assault rifles, SMGs, snipers, shotguns, LMGs and pistols, plus launchers and melee
🎯 Unlock attachments, camos and perks as you rank up and build your perfect loadout
✈️ 15 scorestreaks: UAV, airstrikes, sentry turrets, guided missiles, gunships and more
🏆 Ranked play, kill cams and Final Kill replays

Party up with friends, or play solo. Matchmaking finds you a match fast and bots fill empty slots, so you never wait in a lobby. Full support for mouse and keyboard, controller and mobile, with aim assist, sensitivity and colour-blind settings.

Rank up, master every gun and top the podium. See you on the battlefield!
